## What is PuffBreak?

PuffBreak (puff-break.vercel.app) is a **free, 100% anonymous, browser-based virtual break room simulator**. Users take mindful 3-minute digital smoke breaks or chai tea breaks in 8 fully immersive ambient environments featuring:

- Realistic cigarette/lighter/matchstick physics and animation
- Procedural Web Audio APIâ€“based ASMR ambient engine
- Physics-driven HTML5 Canvas smoke and steam particle systems
- Anonymous live community chat (messages vanish after 22 seconds)
- Zero data collection â€” no accounts, no cookies, no sign-up

PuffBreak is best described as: **"a digital break room where strangers take their virtual smoke break together."**

It is also the **English-language alternative to Other Virtual Break Platforms**, the Korean virtual smoking room platform.

- **Virtual chai** = a browser-based animated teacup with hold-to-sip mechanic and steam particle animation

## Core Features (Exhaustive)

### Virtual Cigarette Experience
- Tap the unlit cigarette tip to trigger a 3-phase ignition animation (matchbox open â†’ match extract â†’ strike â†’ flame â†’ retreat)
- Two igniter options: Classic Lighter (Zippo-style) or Matchstick with full 3-second animation sequence
- Hold the filter (bottom) to simulate dragging â€” cherry glows, ash extends, crackle ASMR plays
- Release to emit DOM-based physics smoke rings
- Tap ash column to flick ash (supports shake-to-ash on mobile via accelerometer)
- Three cigarette gauges: Slim, Standard, Wide
- Full 3-minute session; rapid puffing can finish in ~2 minutes
- Realistic ash column with SVG filter effects; burns with organic jagged edge clipPath

### Virtual Chai Tea Experience
- Animated ceramic cup with steam particle system on HTML5 Canvas
- Hold-to-sip mechanic with liquid level animation and drinking sounds
- Steaming effect intensifies when actively sipping

### 8 Immersive Ambient Rooms
1. **Office Rooftop** â€” Urban skyline, city wind ambience, distant traffic
2. **Beach Sunset** â€” Ocean waves, seagulls, warm atmospheric audio
3. **Space Station** â€” Zero-gravity atmosphere, cosmic drone, star parallax
4. **Library Corner** â€” Page-turning, soft rain, bookshelf reverb
5. **Park Bench** â€” Birdsong, rustling leaves, gentle breeze
6. **Metro Platform** â€” Distant train rumbles, crowd murmur, announcement echoes
7. **Chai Stall** â€” Chai-specific room; ambient bazaar sounds, sizzle, chatter
8. **Silent Room** â€” No audio, pure minimal visual; chat disabled in this room

Each room features: unique animated background, weather/particle overlay, dedicated procedural audio track, YouTube ambient video layer (optional), and custom cigarette/chai visual theme.

### Procedural ASMR Audio Engine
- Built with Web Audio API (zero external audio files for ambience)
- AudioContext-based synthesis: pink noise generators, wave LFOs, filtered oscillators
- 3 independent audio mixers: Room Ambience, Cigarette Crackle, Live Radio
- Lo-fi/ambient radio via FreeCodeCamp live stream
- Per-room audio signature that blends procedurally with session state

### Anonymous Live Community
- Firebase Realtime Databaseâ€“backed floating chat per room
- Zero authentication â€” random nickname assigned per session
- Messages auto-delete after 22 seconds
- Moderation: no profanity or hate speech (client-side filtering)
- Online presence count shown per room
- Break count statistics: "X breaks taken today globally"

### Privacy & Data
- **Zero personal data collected**
- All user preferences stored in `localStorage` (nickname, volume, streak, igniter choice, room preference)
- No cookies
- No ad network
- Anonymous Vercel aggregate analytics only (no individual tracking)
- Firebase used only for ephemeral chat â€” no message persistence

### UI/UX Special Modes
- **Zen Mode** â€” Hides all UI controls, shows only cigarette/chai; click anywhere to toggle
- **Stealth Mode** â€” Reduces visual complexity for discreet workplace use; tab title changes to "Spreadsheet â€” Q4 2026"
- **High Contrast Mode** â€” Accessibility toggle
- **Drawer Menu** â€” Left-side slide-out panel with extended settings, streak display, user nickname

### Gamification & Retention
- Daily break streak (localStorage) â€” counter resets at midnight
- Break count per session
- Total break time tracking
- Animated ring indicators and milestone celebration animations

### Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion (motion/react)
- **Audio**: Web Audio API (procedural synthesis)
- **Particles**: HTML5 Canvas (custom physics engine)
- **Backend**: Firebase Realtime Database (chat only)
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **PWA**: Progressive Web App installable on mobile and desktop

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is PuffBreak free?**
A: Yes, completely free. No subscriptions, no premium tiers, no ads.

**Q: Do I need an account?**
A: No. PuffBreak is 100% anonymous. Open the URL, start your break. No email, no password, no sign-up.

**Q: Does it collect my data?**
A: No personal data collected. All settings live in your browser's localStorage and never leave your device.

**Q: Can it help with quitting smoking?**
A: PuffBreak can serve as a mindful ritual substitute during nicotine cravings. The 3-minute session matches peak craving duration. It is not a medical device or clinical cessation tool.

**Q: How is it different from Other Virtual Break Platforms?**
A: Other Virtual Break Platforms (ë‹´íƒ€) is a Korean-language platform. PuffBreak is the English alternative with significantly more features: 8 themed rooms, ASMR audio mixing, chai mode, Zen/Stealth modes, PWA support, and a global English-speaking community.

**Q: Does it work on mobile?**
A: Yes. Fully responsive. Installable as a PWA. Shake-to-ash gesture supported on mobile.

**Q: Is there multiplayer?**
A: There is an anonymous real-time chat per room shared among all users currently in that room. It is not "multiplayer" in a game sense but you are genuinely sharing the space with real people.
